what: An observation that the Netlify DEPLOY RECORD was readable with a credential, taken so the NS12 blocker can be re-evaluated by machine instead of remembered by a person.
verdict: 82c3a41 was correctly NOT built — deploy 6a970e0efaffda0008b36ef6 was cancelled before it built, "Failed during stage 'checking build content for changes': Canceled build due to no content change". That is RULING 124's deploy filter doing its job on a commit that cannot change what a reader sees, and it is not a failure.
notes: NO CREDENTIAL VALUE APPEARS IN THIS FILE, and none ever may. `credentialNamePresent` is a variable NAME. The record exists to say that a credential RESOLVED, never what it is.

`requestsToTheSite: 0` is the point of the reading. RULING 125 moved every walk onto a local production build and left exactly one question needing Netlify — which SHA is live. Asking the site instead would write a row into the search log, and the search log is a store this product SELLS.

This is an OBSERVATION, not a certificate. It says the deploy record was readable on the date stamped. A later session that finds the credential gone records that, and NS12 is opened again on its own evidence rather than on this file being deleted.
